description: Unit tests for parsing and validating Signed Tree Head (STH) JSON responses and consistency proofs in the net::ct namespace, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: ParsesValidJsonSTH
methods.description: Tests parsing of valid JSON STH and verifies fields match expected values.

methods.name: FailsToParseMissingFields
methods.description: Tests failure when required fields are missing in JSON STH.

methods.name: FailsToParseIncorrectLengthRootHash
methods.description: Tests failure when root hash length is incorrect.

methods.name: ParsesJsonSTHWithLargeTimestamp
methods.description: Tests parsing of STH JSON with a large timestamp value.

methods.name: ParsesConsistencyProofSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid consistency proof JSON.

methods.name: FailsOnInvalidProofJson
methods.description: Tests failure cases for invalid proof JSON inputs.

methods.name: ParsesProofJsonWithExtraFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of proof JSON with additional unrelated fields.
